summary.text: BILRETUR AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2005-06-27. BILRETUR AS receives, collects and processes end-of-life vehicles, and carries out activities connected to this. Its main industry code is 46.870: wholesale of waste and scrap. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 109 644 061 NOK and the annual result was 1 673 807 NOK; operating income was down from 110 497 235 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 1 657 765 NOK in 2024 to 1 673 807 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 15 844 798 NOK in 2024 to 17 504 084 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is bilretur.as, which links to its Facebook profile. It holds a Legal Entity Identifier (2549009GI2IJ7FTTOT68). The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-11 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
